# Engineered Solutions of Georgia (ESOG)

> > Foundation repair, basement waterproofing, and concrete lifting specialists serving Atlanta and the Southeast with pressure grouting, polylifting, and structural stabilization solutions.

Engineered Solutions of Georgia (ESOG) provides comprehensive foundation repair and waterproofing services throughout Georgia, Alabama, and Tennessee. The company specializes in advanced techniques including pressure grouting, compaction grouting, polylifting, foundation piering, crawlspace encapsulation, and both interior and exterior waterproofing systems backed by their Triple Protection Warranty.

## Key Topics

- Foundation Repair
- Basement Waterproofing
- Pressure Grouting
- Polylifting & Mudjacking
- Foundation Piering
- Crawlspace Encapsulation
- Vapor Barriers
- Compaction Grouting
- Sump Pump Systems
- Concrete Crack Repair
- Interior & Exterior Waterproofing
- Structural Stabilization
- Moisture Control
- Triple Protection Warranty
- Atlanta Metro Services
